note: Edges that fork a universe. They are the lasting choices already in the garden. Branching records the fork and derives the child seed. It does not resimulate the year.

choices.label: Let there be light
choices.summary: Dawn. The Day 1 garden's let_there_be_light state is true, and the valley is lit.

choices.label: Leave the dark
choices.summary: The dark remains. The Day 1 garden stays in the darkness state.

choices.label: The garden kept
choices.summary: They leave the fruit because God asked, and the garden is kept.

choices.label: East of the garden
choices.summary: They ate, and God walked them east of the garden.

choices.label: The open orchard
choices.summary: No law had been set, so the bite does not exile them.

choices.label: The closed question
choices.summary: The fruit is out of reach. Wonder is the thing that is missing.

choices.label: Keep them in the valley
choices.summary: The people stay in the valley.

choices.label: Bless a pact
choices.summary: Two holds exchange grain, wood, and a spare tool, and their people stay.

choices.label: Withhold the pact
choices.summary: Nothing is sent that year, and someone may leave the poorer hearth.

choices.label: Stop the raid
choices.summary: The stores stay, and the people stay.

choices.label: Let the raid go
choices.summary: A hungry hold carries off grain, wood, and a tool.

choices.label: Send rain
choices.summary: Rain fills water and grain and puts fish in the nets.

choices.label: Send a drought
choices.summary: Drought dries the stores, thins the herd, and slows the outdoor work.

choices.label: Send a flood
choices.summary: A flood carries off grain and wood and scatters a head of the herd.

choices.label: Bless the present
choices.summary: The present is blessed, and the west quarter can be planted.

choices.label: Keep a commons
choices.summary: A tenth of the richer store moves to the poorer hold.
